description: Responsible for translating ECS data into visual output using Dart's low-level UI bindings (dart:ui), bypassing Flutter entirely.
responsibilities: Hook into PlatformDispatcher to sync with the device's display refresh (VSync)
Implement systems that read Position/Sprite components and issue draw calls
Maximize rendering performance using batching (drawAtlas) for thousands of sprites
Manage assets (images, shaders) loading and memory lifecycle outside of Flutter
context: Sting uses no Flutter Widgets. All rendering is done by issuing commands directly to Impeller/Skia via dart:ui. Aim to minimize draw calls.
